name: ahc027 Cleaning route

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.
notes: C++20 source, ALE-Bench case generator/judge and its separately installed helper. Each call evaluates 50 public cases using 13 workers. Full private evaluation is a separate protocol.

evaluator_adapter.notes: Signature and metric inspected at the pinned official source. Added during second source gap pass; not runtime-tested in this pass. Previously unresolved safe_ale_session helper located in official SakanaAI/ALE-Bench and verified at immutable commit 3da9b12fb5d112dabb3af693d1a42031c95142bc. Accepted judge status is the literal ACCEPTED.

setup_instructions: Install/start Docker and CairoSVG native prerequisites per https://github.com/SakanaAI/ALE-Bench/blob/3da9b12fb5d112dabb3af693d1a42031c95142bc/README.md#setup

Clone https://github.com/SakanaAI/ALE-Bench at 3da9b12fb5d112dabb3af693d1a42031c95142bc and run scripts/docker_build_all.sh with your numeric UID and GID as its two arguments. These official scripts build the judge Docker images.
Benchmark cases are downloaded on demand from SakanaAI/ALE-Bench on Hugging Face; optionally set ALE_BENCH_DATA to a local dataset checkout.

science_relevance.definition: A task is important to science when it addresses a substantive scientific or real-world problem, and a cited research paper's main objective is to solve that problem or advance understanding of it. The evidence must explain why the problem matters and how the local task represents it. Using a task to evaluate an agent, framework, or general-purpose model, or citing only a benchmark, dataset, or tool, does not establish scientific importance.

merged_from.description: ALE-Bench LITE: optimize the candidate specified by the paper and evaluate against the named benchmark.

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

notes: Task ID verified in the official benchmark manifest. ShinkaEvolve-specific initial ALE-Agent solution and evolution driver were not located in current source tree.

limitations: Upstream commands and dependencies were inspected; costly training, paid APIs, and hardware experiments were not executed.
Current public examples retain circle packing but do not include verified AIME, ALE-Bench LITE, or MoE experiment drivers. Later added examples are not included as paper evaluations.

Original public release v0.0.1 (commit23decc6bf118d783ddff5a3c03d2269cbf149971) was also inspected: its example directories are circle_packing, game_2048, julia_prime_counting and novelty_generator, with no released AIME, ALE or MoE evaluator.
No complete, verified execution adapter has been established for this exact task; this package is an explicit implementation gap.
